terminals.name: mock-sentinel
terminals.command: set -a; source .env; set +a; export PYTHONPATH="$PWD"; exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn mock.sentinel_api:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8081

terminals.name: collector-api
terminals.command: set -a; source .env; set +a; export PYTHONPATH="$PWD"; exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn collector.api:api --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080

terminals.name: sentinel-worker
terminals.command: set -a; source .env; set +a; export PYTHONPATH="$PWD"; export PROCRASTINATE_APP=collector.app.app; exec .venv/bin/python -m procrastinate worker -q sentinel -c 1 --delete-jobs never
